description: Port of ESLint's `sort-vars` (https://eslint.org/docs/latest/rules/sort-vars): flags an identifier declarator when an earlier identifier declarator of the same declaration sorts after it. ESLint's sorting autofix is not reproduced. Options are declared in the `options` define (the rule's defaults); a variant is a config patch.

violation.message: Variables within the same declaration block should be sorted alphabetically.
